The failed pods (restarted after node-taints were removed) ran `nginx:1.31.5`, so the class was actually provisionable—the claim itself was unprovisionable.

kind: PersistentVolume
metadata: {name: fast-ssd-pv, labels: {app: app}}
spec:
  capacity: {storage: 1Gi}
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer  # Matches PVC's WaitForFirstConsumer
  volumeNodeSelector: {nodeAffinity: {node: benchmark-pvc-pending}} # Single node cluster

```
